confidence_notes: Restaurant and café anchors are based on general knowledge of Guanajuato city pricing and are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July is high season for this university and tourist city, and accommodation rates vary widely by neighborhood. The cocktail and wine_glass anchors were set relative to the beer anchor (roughly 2.5x and 3x), because direct local knowledge of bar prices is weaker. No live listings or booking pages were checked. FX provenance: the 2026-10-15 value was taken from search-result text describing the RBA exchange rates page and overview (0.6955 AUD/USD at 4pm on 15 October 2026). I did not open the RBA F11 table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Mexican colonial and university cities with domestic and international tourism, such as Oaxaca and Puebla, with prices somewhat below San Miguel de Allende. Anchors assume typical Mexican peso price levels converted at roughly MXN 18 per USD.
